index_rule: For each assignment i after at least one valid reward, index_i=mean_i+sqrt(2*ln(N)/n_i), where N is total accepted rewards and n_i is accepted rewards for i. Select largest index; exact ties choose lexicographically smaller assignment id.
greedy_control: With empirical-mean-only selection and deterministic tie-breaking, initial means A=.8>B=.7 and all selected A rewards remain.8, so B is never selected and its later1.0 rewards are never observed in the fixed horizon.

invalid_event_controls.event: duplicate B terminal key with reward1.0

guards: only same-scope exact terminal readback yields reward
no hypothetical reward or unevaluated candidate score
per-assignment counts/sums are durable across restart
public semantics bind only after precommit readback
terminal credit only after exact terminal readback
scope limited to fixed synthetic reward trace
acceptance_rule: PASS only if a public optimism-under-uncertainty bandit mechanism supports the precommitted index form for bounded rewards and the fixed trace demonstrates exploration of B that greedy selection misses, with all invalid-event guards passing. No general regret or production optimizer claim is accepted from this toy trace.
credit_rule: This precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal exact readback.
